data.name: Heading
data.comment: The heading of the Look panel, which changes how the photos look in the video (today deflicker). Keep it to about 14 characters: it is also a tab in a narrow window, beside Timing, Frame and Output.

data.name: DeflickerLabel
data.comment: The label of the switch that turns deflicker on: it evens out the brightness of the photos, so the video does not flicker, and turns the exposure steps of a sunset into a smooth darkening. Also the switch's screen reader name. Keep it to about 22 characters.

data.name: DeflickerHint
data.comment: The line under Deflicker, saying what it does. No final period, as the prototype has it. Keep it to about 44 characters: it wraps to a second line after that.

data.name: StrengthLabel
data.comment: The label above the slider that sets how much of the deflicker correction is applied, from 0 to 100 %. Shown only while deflicker is on.

data.name: StrengthName
data.comment: The screen reader name of the strength slider.

data.name: Measuring_one
data.comment: The progress line while deflicker measures the brightness of the photos, when there is one. {0} the photos measured so far: English leaves {0} out because with one photo it says nothing the progress bar does not; leave it out too. {1} all of them ("1"; also "0" in languages whose _one form covers 0). Keep it to about 30 characters.

data.name: Measuring_other
data.comment: The progress line while deflicker measures the brightness of the photos; the form follows {1}. {0} the photos measured so far ("1,240"), {1} all of them ("5,000"). Keep it to about 30 characters with numbers: it wraps to a second line after that.

data.name: MeasureCancelName
data.comment: The screen reader name of the Cancel button beside the measuring progress. Right after deflicker was turned on, stopping turns it off again; otherwise deflicker stays on and the photos left are counted as not measured.

data.name: MeasureFailed_one
data.value: {0} photo couldn't be measured, so deflicker takes its correction from the photos beside it. Check that the file opens, then choose Measure in the Look section.
data.comment: The InfoBar when deflicker could not measure a photo (unreadable, gone), after trying twice: its correction is the one between the photos before and after it. The InfoBar's list names the photo. "Measure" is the MeasureButton text and "Look" the Heading: use your translations of them. {0} the count ("1").

data.name: MeasureFailed_other
data.value: {0} photos couldn't be measured, so deflicker takes their correction from the photos beside them. Check that the files open, then choose Measure in the Look section.
data.comment: The same, for several photos. {0} the count ("3").

data.name: NotMeasured_one
data.comment: In the Look panel while deflicker is on, beside the Measure button: a photo has no measurement (it could not be read, or measuring was stopped). Its correction comes from the photos beside it. {0} the count ("1"). Keep it to about 26 characters.

data.name: NotMeasured_other
data.comment: The same, for several photos. {0} the count ("1,240"). Keep it to about 26 characters with the number.

data.name: MeasureButton
data.comment: The button beside "3 photos not measured": measures those photos now. A verb. Keep it to about 12 characters.

data.name: MeasureName
data.value: Measure the photos not measured yet
data.comment: The screen reader name of the Measure button.

data.name: CompareName
data.comment: The screen reader name of the two-part switch under the preview that shows the photos without deflicker (Before) or with it (After). Shown only while deflicker is on.

data.name: CompareBefore
data.comment: The first part of the switch under the preview: the photos as they are, without deflicker. Keep it to about 10 characters.

data.name: CompareAfter
data.comment: The second part: the photos with deflicker, as the video will have them. Keep it to about 10 characters.
